# Rating scale change (generated by src/06_ratings.py, D37, REVIEW_1 item 3)

Old: each shrunk component divided by its own SD after shrinkage, consistency m capped at 60. New: each shrunk component divided by the SD of its raw (unshrunk) values across the eligible pool, no cap on m. Nominal weights 60 / 15 / 25 (level / shift / consistency). Effective weight = nominal weight x SD of the component's z-score, rescaled to sum to 100: how much of the rating's spread each component actually drives.
